description: This file defines a PHP interface 'ReportData' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report'. The interface declares methods for normalizing report data to an array and retrieving associated metadata as a ParameterBag object or null.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Method to normalize the report data object into an associative array.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Method to retrieve metadata associated with the report data, returning a ParameterBag instance or null.
